verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm SDK-level filtering of sensitive data before it's sent (client-side scrubbing) and an IP-address suppression toggle, which addresses part of the story. However, there is no evidence of server-side scrubbing rules applied after ingestion, no mention of PII-specific pattern rules (e.g., regex-based field scrubbing), and no confirmation that filtered data never persists server-side. missing for 10: server-side scrubbing rule engine, documented PII-pattern/regex filtering, confirmation of non-persistence guarantees, independent verification of scrubbing efficacy.
